text:
Mia Chen: ok folks, we need to finalize the Apr 18 webinar. Primary goal = convert trial users into Dedicated evals + surface Private interest. Proposed angle: "Benchmarks -> SLOs: predictable LLM inference in production". thoughts?

Arjun Patel: that angle works. I can demo smart routing + fallback behavior. prefer 10m for infra + 5m quick failover demo.

Liz Torres: I'll own the product narrative and the Optimize tips. planning 12 mins + 1 benchmark slide (cost vs latency).

Samir Gupta: CS will bring a brief customer vignette. we should keep it ~7 minutes and focus on migration story. will moderate Qs too.

marketing-bot: Reminder: speaker slide deadline 2024-04-10. Landing page draft available: https://airtable.com/shrExample. Tags: trial-users, enterprise, platform.

Nathan Lee: customer is comfortable but prefers pre-recorded demo clip to avoid network issues. can appear live for Qs.

Mia Chen: draft run-of-show (50m total + 2m buffer):
- 00:00-03:00 — welcome & goals (Mia)
- 03:00-15:00 — product + Optimize (Liz)
- 15:00-27:00 — infra & routing (Arjun) — includes 3m live demo + fallback
- 27:00-35:00 — customer vignette (Nathan + Samir)
- 35:00-48:00 — live Q&A (panel)
- 48:00-50:00 — CTAs & close (Liz + Mia)
Notes: record session, enable captions, two demo fallbacks (pre-record + replay snippet). ops: need stream key + captions enabled.

Arjun Patel: timeline acked. will post 99p/median numbers for small/medium/large configs and a 60s scripted demo by EOD. demo fallback plan (if live fails):
```
# fallback: replay pre-recorded clip from S3
curl -X GET https://s3.redwood.ai/webinars/apr18/demo-fallback.mp4 -o demo.mp4
# or replay canned API example
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -d '{"model":"rwd-infer-3b","input":"Summarize this doc"}'
```

Liz Torres: please include token-cost per 1k tokens for each config. @Arjun can you add a simple chart for the slide? also want a single bullet slide with SLO recommendations (p50, p95, p99 thresholds).

Arjun Patel: will attach CSV + chart by EOD. Also requested infra to reserve a small GPU instance for the demo rehearsal (no heavy load). ops: can you confirm reservation? @ops

marketing-bot: Registration slug set to /webinars/benchmarks-to-slos. Added fields: region, company_size, use_case.

Nathan Lee: I'll pre-record the customer demo clip and deliver by 2024-04-14. can we schedule a quick alignment call on 4/15?

Mia Chen: yes. Rehearsal windows: 2024-04-16 10:00 PT (preferred) or 2024-04-17 15:00 PT. Everyone ok?

Liz Torres: 4/16 10:00 PT works for me.

Arjun Patel: 4/16 good.

Samir Gupta: good. I'll confirm customer permission for logo/quotes by 4/12.

Nathan Lee: will confirm exact speaker name by 4/11 and upload the clip by 4/14.

Mia Chen: action items recap:
- Liz: final deck & CTA bullets by 2024-04-10
- Arjun: benchmark CSV, chart, demo script + fallback snippets by EOD today; pre-record template if needed
- Nathan: customer clip by 2024-04-14, confirm speaker name by 4/11
- Samir: privacy approvals by 4/12
- Ops: stream key + captions + demo instance reserved before rehearsal

Arjun Patel: posting the 99p numbers now (small/med/large): 99p: 180ms / 230ms / 620ms; median: 45ms / 60ms / 210ms. attached CSV: benchmarks_apr18.csv

Liz Torres: thanks. I'll build the SLO slide: recommendation = p95 < 250ms for interactive, fall back to smaller model or cache for tail cases.

Samir Gupta: suggestion: include a 2-slide appendix with migration checklist for Dedicated -> Private. short bullets only.

Mia Chen: good call. Also ops question: can we enable live captioning and automated recording to S3? @ops please confirm.

marketing-bot: Added webinar to promo calendar. Suggested social post dates: 2024-04-04 (announce), 2024-04-11 (speakers), 2024-04-16 (reminder).

Mia Chen: perfect. I'll send calendar invites + link to shared runbook (slides + assets + backup videos). We'll run the full dress rehearsal 4/16 10:00 PT. If anyone needs a separate dry-run for their clip, ping me and I'll book slots. :white_check_mark:

Nathan Lee: thanks — I'll post the customer clip link here once uploaded.

Arjun Patel: uploaded demo script & fallback clips to the runbook. short checklist for rehearsal: mic test, camera on for panel, screen-share permissions, pre-play fallback clip.

Liz Torres: content lock reminder: please no slide edits after 4/10 unless critical.

Mia Chen: noted. any other blockers?

Samir Gupta: none from CS aside from the privacy checkpoint (I'll update).

Mia Chen: great. closing thread — final runbook + rehearsal invite incoming.
